evidence: Matches the Tests label and adds a new shared unit test utility module (`src/test/util/common.{h,cpp}`) to improve test framework failure output across test suites.
rationale: Improves unit test failure diagnostics by defining stream output operators and migrating assertions to `BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL`. As noted in the description, when `BOOST_CHECK(a == b)` failed, Boost only reported a boolean failure without printing mismatched values; this provides better test signal and aids framework migration work (#35713).
